hints.title: Substation Connectivity Model
hints.text: Treat the electrical network as an undirected graph where connected components represent energized islands.

hints.title: Edge Disablement Simulation
hints.text: For each maintenance inquiry, rebuild or evaluate component connectivity excluding the serviced transmission line.

hints.title: Component Count Recording
hints.text: Count the number of disjoint trees or groups remaining after the edge is bypassed.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Component enumeration per query via disjoint set union.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full recursive tree traversals without path compression incur extra overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear parent array represents partitions with constant auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track connected components using disjoint set union upon edge omission.
